subject: Goal endorsement playbook and sign-off coordination
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Goal endorsement playbook — proposed next steps

Team —

Attached is a clean pass of the Q3 OKR draft (Q3_OKR_Draft_v3.xlsx) and a short playbook for endorsement timing. High level ask: get alignment on measurable changes by EOD Wednesday so we can route an exec sign-off packet on Thursday.

Key steps I propose:
- Internal review (you): note metric deltas or objections in the draft file (highlight + comment).
- Partner ask (Priyanka): confirm any procurement or timeline constraints from Acme by EOD Wed.
- Comms & QBR prep (Grace): assemble a one-slide summary and a short comms plan.

I can run a 30-minute sync Friday 10–10:30 PT if that helps to finalize any open items.

Attachments: Q3_OKR_Draft_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), endorsement_playbook.docx (doc)

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Goal endorsement playbook — proposed next steps

Marcus —

Thanks for sending this through. Quick notes inline below and attached a small metric rubric (metric_rubric.xlsx) with the proposed threshold changes.

> Key steps I propose:
> - Internal review (you): note metric deltas or objections in the draft file (highlight + comment).

On the metrics: I pushed back on two of the throughput targets — they look optimistic vs. our Q2 baseline. Suggested change: adjust throughput SLO ramp to 12% instead of 20% and include a risk clause for model-quantization experiments.

I agree with the timeline to route the exec packet on Thursday; will circulate my annotated sheet by EOD tomorrow.

-Kimberly
VP, Growth & GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachment: metric_rubric.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@acmecorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Goal endorsement playbook — proposed next steps

Marcus / team —

Thanks for including Acme. Quick confirmation from procurement: any change in data retention language or private deployment SLAs will add an extra procurement milestone — we need that flagged on the mutual action plan.

From our side we can commit to a signed MOU within two weeks once the final SLA/terms are locked. I added procurement@acmecorp.com on CC so they can surface any required paperwork.

Happy to join the Friday check-in if useful.

—Priyanka
Product Partnerships, Acme Corporation

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Goal endorsement playbook — proposed next steps

Thanks — small operational asks and a proposed slide template for QBR:

1) Please include a single-row "gating" column in the OKR sheet indicating: data retention change? SLA delta? procurement dependency? This will help the QBR audience quickly see which objectives require legal/procurement sign-off.
2) I started a one-slide summary and a draft comms plan (comms_plan.md). I'll drop the slide into the Drive link you shared.

I also think we should formalize the mutual action plan (MAP) so Acme and Redwood have identical milestones. Marcus — can you own consolidating comments into the MAP doc and send the final packet to execs by Thursday morning? If you can't, I'll take it but need confirmation before noon Wednesday.

Grace
Director, Redwood Console & Observability

> On Thu May 13, 2027 at 9:03 AM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> Attached is a clean pass of the Q3 OKR draft (Q3_OKR_Draft_v3.xlsx)...

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@acmececorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Goal endorsement playbook — proposed next steps (final packet)

All —

Thanks for the quick turn. I consolidated Kimberly's rubric, Grace's comms slide, and Priyanka's procurement notes into the final packet and uploaded: Q3_OKR_Final_v1.xlsx (final OKR table) and MAP_Final.pdf (mutual action plan).

Action items closed:
- Kimberly: rubric incorporated and throughput SLO adjusted to 12% with a quantization-risk clause.
- Grace: comms slide included in the deck and Drive link updated.
- Priyanka / procurement: added procurement milestone and timeline to MAP.

Next steps: I'll route the exec packet for endorsement now — expected sign-off turnaround: 24 hours. After exec endorsement we'll issue the DocuSign packet (link below) and finalize comms.

DocuSign for exec approval: https://docusign.com/track/ABC-OKR-SIGN-2027
Drive (final packet): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cQ3R4_okr-final

Attachments: Q3_OKR_Final_v1.xlsx, MAP_Final.pdf

Thanks —
Marcus

Redwood Inference
